programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A teenage boy (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) suspects that the tenant (Judd Nelson) now taking up residence in his mother's backyard apartment is actually an alien on a deadly mission…a suspicion that puts the boy and his mother in grave danger.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An anarchist (Frank Whaley), who was once rabidly pro-technology, threatens to blow up the central computers that control the world. As he negotiates with Pete Yastremski (John Amos) to surrender, we discover what led him down this dark path.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When the leader of an Arctic exploration team kills two colleagues, psychologist Jack Burrell (William Cummins) is sent up to counsel the staff, including an old "friend" (Robert Sean Leonard), and to find the cause of an infectious psychosis.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Time-traveler Dr. Theresa Givens (Amanda Plummer) faces the death penalty for using her time machine in a future where all technology is banned due to a devastating nuclear holocaust some 20 years earlier. Charlton Heston also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An overworked father who wants to relieve the tension in his home due to the demands of his job orders a robot to keep house and perform other chores. Much to the father's surprise, the robot starts to replace him as head of the household.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A military colonel travels into the past from a plagued-ridden future where billions have died from a deadly virus. His mission: track down Patient Zero, the woman who had all three strains of DNA that produced the virus and assassinate her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A couple and their friend join a mysterious religious sect in order to lead a more spiritual existence and find a new direction in life. They soon learn, however, that their new-found direction may take them further than they ever thought possible.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Young and artistic Claire Linkwood, who struggles financially to make ends meet, volunteers for a surrogate mother program. But after the embryo is successfully implanted at the clinic, she begins to have nightmares of a most "alien" nature.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The lone survivor (Jere Burns) of a space shuttle disaster discovers he's greatly transformed since surviving the crash. For one, his body seems to be indestructible, and he embraces a new-found humanity…courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Mona Lisa, an android who was created to spy and kill, is designed with superior intelligence. But it is that superior intellect which allows her to evolve, leading her to question the morality of her prime directive...and her own existence.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A biogeneticist clones successfully his wife, who is near death in a coma with no expectation of survival. But when his real wife suddenly awakens from her coma, he finds life with not one, but two wives may be quite complicated.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man (Enrico Colantoni) has second thoughts about a process that transmits a copy of a person light years away but requires that the human "shell" left behind be destroyed in order to maintain a balance in the Universe.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An unemployed man wanders into a curio shop owned by a shape-shifting alien and is offered a rather unique wallet...one that fills with the money of anyone the man comes in physical contact with. However, if it's too good to be true, it often is.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A dying scientist (Joanna Going) makes it her mission to save a mutant "child" -- a link to another dimension of time and space -- from those scientists who seek fame and from shadowy government forces that desire to exploit it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A four-person space crew travels through a wormhole that lands them in an unknown universe where Native American Astrophysicist Callie Whitehorse Landau experiences bizarre hallucinations that reveal the true nature of the entire universe.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an alien seed travels through space and lands on Earth in a rooftop garden, the exotic "flower" it spawns turns out to be an alluring woman who consumes the life and energy out of human victims in the attempt to perpetuate her species on Earth.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a botched military experiment some four years earlier resulted in the death of one of the test subjects, a doctor now believes the deceased test subject's vengeful spirit is able to jump from one body to another…and is after her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In an effort to help the mentally ill, a psychiatrist (Jamie Lunar) creates a device that allows her to enter the subconscious of her patients. But when things go wrong, she finds that her own sanity -- and possibly her life -- may be in danger.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A time traveler recruits a young woman from present day to join a team of time travelers-for-hire, but when she ends up attempting to change her own past, doing irreparable damage to the present and the future, the institute must race to stop her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an alien abducts five students and transports them to a reproduction of their school, it informs them that they are part of a grand experiment. But as part of that experiment, together they must decide which of the five should be killed.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A circuit court judge (Dennis Haysbert) agrees to preside over a case on a colonized planet that has never had any organized rule of law. On a world in which humans and aliens live side by side, he finds his first case is one of murder.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A desperate high school wrestling coach gives his team an untested performance-enhancing inhalant. Of course, the team suddenly starts winning…but their victory may be short-lived as the drug comes with killer side effects.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An employee of a computer company uncovers a plot by its CEO/founder to take control of the world's computer network by having computers communicate at a more sentient level and, if successful, set himself up for world domination

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman who was abducted by aliens 17 years earlier tries to move past the mental scars, especially for the sake of her daughter, and finds love with a new teacher at her daughter's school. But she soon learns he is not the man he appears to be.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A rogue android who is part of the crew on Ganymede outpost threatens to destroy Earth's last hope of survival, claiming that human beings are no better than an infestation in the universe and not worthy of survival. And perhaps he is right…

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A test to find the right soldier for a secret mission pushes the limits of each of the candidates. Placed in seemingly real and very dangerous situations, the candidates soon find the line between reality and simulation inexorably blurred.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Laurie-Ann emailed Dr. Phil claiming she was robbed by her dangerous, narcissist ex-boyfriend and his new fiancée, Alison. She claims her ex, Michael, held her hostage for seven years. Laurie-Ann claims Michael and Alison are retaliating against her for breaking her silence and filing charges against Michael for domestic violence, emotional abuse, theft, and fraud. But Michael and Alison say Laurie-Ann is a liar who is always playing the victim. Michael says he never held her hostage; she only started to say that because he dumped her. Alison says she just wants Laurie-Ann to move on with her life, let them be happy, and stop stalking them. But Laurie-Ann says Alison doesn’t know how vindictive Michael really is and she claims he has turned everyone, including the police, against her. Laurie-Ann says she wants Dr. Phil to validate her story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: How to Get to I Do
programme.desc: For many girls, a fairytale wedding day is a sweet fantasy -- but getting the proposal can be a real nightmare! Amber and Rich are struggling through commitment issues. They live, work and have children together, and say they're happy but can't seem to take the next step. Rich sold Amber on his plan to marry her after five years, so why hasn't he proposed after nearly seven? Does he have valid reasons for resisting marriage? After Dr. Phil challenges him, will Rich decide to walk down the aisle ... on Dr. Phil's stage? Next, Jill has taken the leap and been divorced seven times. Why does she pick the wrong men, and what can she do to make her next union last? Then, Candy describes her first marriage as lasting 18 miserable years, and she regrets how she poisoned her daughters against men during that time. What will it take to change her daughter, who calls herself the Runaway Bride? Plus, a don't-miss moment happens in Dr. Phil's audience!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Angelique recounts escaping a life-threatening scheme while pregnant.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Son Believes He’s a Cyborg
programme.desc: Can Dr. Phil convince a 24 yo NYU grad that he’s not a cyborg from the future?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The contentious 2020 presidential election has shown that there’s a clear divide in America – half the country is celebrating, and the other half is angry – making the upcoming holiday season especially tricky to navigate. Instead of being a time of joy, celebration and giving thanks, many families are faced with the dilemma of how not to argue with their own spouses, children and parents about politics. Dr. Phil meets a Republican father, who is barely speaking to his Democrat daughter after an argument they had over Donald Trump. Then, Dr. Phil meets another father, a lifelong Democrat, who says he raised his son to be a free thinker ... but never imagined that he’d support Trump! The election is officially over, but the drama remains. What’s Dr. Phil’s advice on how to move forward post- election without turning holiday dinners with family into a war zone over politics? Tune in!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Cherylyn says she loves living the high life and admits she is a spoiled and entitled“princess”who has spent tens of thousands of other people’s money on her lavish lifestyle. Cherylyn says she maxed out her 19 credit cards on designer shoes, handbags, purses, clothes, makeup and pampering! And, Cherylyn says she insists on fine dining, fast cars and her boyfriend, Tyler, footing the bill. However, Tyler says he has nothing more to give Cherylyn except an ultimatum, which he delivers when he comes face-to-face with her onstage. Cherylyn's mom, Joey, says that her selfish and manipulative daughter has blown over $130,000 in less than a year and her spending has left a trail of devastation which includes pawning over $7,000 worth of family heirlooms and stealing her identity. Sparks fly when Cherylyn defends her entitled behavior during the taping. What jaw-dropping statement does an unrepentant Cherylyn make to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They’re self-absorbed, spoiled and entitled brats, otherwise known as Generation Me. MTV correspondent Kim Stolz recently hit the streets of New York to find out how the younger generation feels about this label. Don't miss the candid responses. Then, Bradley, 24, says he wants to be rich and drive a Lamborghini, but he only wants to put in 80 percent of the effort. He still relies on his mom, Christine, to pay his rent and other bills. programme.title: The Basement Office

programme.title: The Basement Office
programme.sub-title: My black triangle UFO sighting & Rendlesham Forest UFO encounter Part 1
programme.desc: In this episode of “The Basement Office,” Steven Greenstreet reveals a close encounter he had with a black, triangular UFO in Provo, Utah, in 2003. Nick Pope helps Steven come to terms with what he saw, and helps explain why so many similar UFO sightings go unreported. Then, Charles Halt discusses his shock at his UFO sighting in Rendlesham Forest in 1980 and the audio recording he made during the event.

programme.title: The Basement Office
programme.desc: In this episode of “The Basement Office,” we return to Rendlesham Forest in 1980, the site of England’s most infamous UFO sighting. Staff Sgt. Jim Penniston was on security duty at RAF Bentwaters when he was sent out to investigate an aircraft crash in the woods.

programme.title: The Basement Office

programme.desc: On April 27 the Department of Defense issued a statement confirming the release of three videos showing US Navy jets chasing "unidentified aerial phenomena" -- that's the approved military term for what the public calls UFOs.

programme.title: The Basement Office
programme.sub-title: Underwater UFOs add to US Navy mystery
programme.desc: In 2004, US Navy pilots encountered multiple fast-moving UFOs off the coast of San Diego, California. While this story is now widely known, one detail from the USS Nimitz incident has oft been overlooked... that they also witnessed a UFO under the surface of the ocean.

programme.title: The Basement Office
programme.sub-title: World War II UFOs, Antarctica and Kecksburg Crash
programme.desc: There is one wild conspiracy theory that refuses to go away... that UFOs originated in Germany during World War II, that they built a secret UFO base in Antarctica, and that one of these UFOs crashed in Kecksburg, Pennsylvania in 1965.

programme.title: The Basement Office
programme.sub-title: UFO sightings with aliens & Close Encounters
programme.desc: There are many documented cases of witnesses claiming to have not only seen a UFO, but they also claim to have seen the occupants of that UFO. In pop culture, these "occupants" are often referred to as "aliens".

programme.title: The Basement Office
programme.sub-title: Alien Abduction, Betty and Barney Hill, Travis Walton and more
programme.desc: Alien abduction is something most people have heard of before. programme.title: The Basement Office

programme.desc: Lue Elizondo is a former intelligence officer with the Department of Defense. He claims he was the director of AATIP, the Pentagon's "UFO program", from 2010-2017. In this exclusive interview with Steven Greenstreet of "The Basement Office", Elizondo reveals shocking truths about the UFOs the Navy and other military branches have encountered on almost "a daily basis", why some "very senior" officials at the Pentagon tried to suppress UFO evidence, and the jaw-dropping things these UFOs can do.

programme.title: The Basement Office

programme.desc: In 2004, Ruby, a college student witnesses a supernatural horror at a local sorority house where three women, known as The Takers, kill and drain the life out of her friends to preserve their youth and beauty. 20 years later, now a detective, ghosts from her past resurface, and she must face these demons once again.

programme.title: Rhythm and Revenge
programme.desc: After losing her parents, Journi, a talented but troubled teenager, moves in with her aunt and cousin for a fresh start. As she navigates the pressures of competitive dance, strange accidents begin to occur around her. Suspicion grows, but Journi always seems one step ahead, charming her way out of trouble. However, when the truth starts to unravel, danger lurks closer than anyone could have imagined.

When the remains of an apartheid-era policeman are discovered 60 years after he went missing, a retired singer revisits her past to help with the investigation. But how much does she know, and what is she holding back?

programme.title: The New Girl
programme.desc: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica’s seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister. She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister’s life but her own.

programme.title: A Secret Lie in Love
programme.desc: Clarice and Chase Scott have the perfect suburban life on the outside. However, their marriage that was built on passion, has become a battlefield of deceit, infidelity, and betrayal. Clarice finds solace in the arms of another man, while Chase’s greed seems to unravel everything they’ve built. Will their marriage survive?

programme.title: Tethered Hearts
programme.desc: Token is a charismatic club owner who’s inherited his father’s iconic jazz club, and uses it at a sanctuary for the broken and struggling artists. When a shady music executive starts to recruit his talent, he fights to keep his club afloat.

programme.title: The 4th Quarter: Legacy
programme.desc: Aging quarterback, Dallas Hughes, returns to the game in a make or break season, after failing to lead his team to the playoffs and the team has drafted his replacement. Set against the backdrop of Atlanta sports, Dallas must come to grips with his future, while putting the pieces back together of his broken family.

programme.title: Tainted
programme.desc: After growing up in an abusive home from her Mom, Desi continuously runs into problems with men treating her the way her Mom did, until she snaps.

programme.title: Sudden Death
programme.desc: The gallery forests of the Serengeti are the realm of a phantom. The shadowy thickets are the domain of a Leopardess.

programme.title: Haunted Huntress
programme.desc: A brook in the Serengeti is the home of a leopardess. The secret queen of the shadows took care of her son and has done a good job so far but the adventure continues.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: In the first episode of the three-part series, The Biblical Plagues, scholars deal with the first six natural disasters. In the Nile, scientists discovered deadly microorganisms that caused the fish to die and a stress situation among the frog population.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: For a long time, scientists have tried to prove that nine of the Ten Plagues described in the Old Testament point to a serious breakdown of the climate, triggering an ecological chain reaction. Apart from theological considerations, scholars all over the world have studied individual phenomena, trying to explain the causes of this Biblical disaster.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: Although nine disastrous plagues had already devastated the land along the Nile, Pharaoh remained stubborn and would not release Moses and his people from slavery. And so their God, Yahweh, planned his final assault: At midnight, he sent death over Egypt – all the firstborn, Man or beats, had to die … there was no escape.

programme.title: Monsters and Myths
programme.desc: Monsters have always been part of our nightmares and fairy tales. But where do they actually come from? How much of them is truth, how much is myth? Going to great lengths in this documentary, the filmmakers join scientists to explore a number of the best known sagas and legends in the world.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “... all the waters that were in the river [Nile] were turned to blood. And all the fish that was in the river died,” reports the Bible, “and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river.” (Exodus 7:20–21).

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… so there were lice upon man, and upon beast,” reports the Bible, “all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.” (Exodus 8:18, 17). Even today, two million people die every year from malaria transmitted by mosquitoes, mainly in Africa.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… and the Lord sent thunder and hail, … and fire mingled with the hail,” reports the Old Testament. “And the hail smote … all that was in the field, both man and beast.” (Exodus 9:23–25).

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “... locusts … invaded all Egypt …. They covered all the ground until it was black,” reports the Bible. “They devoured … everything growing in the fields … – nothing green remained on trees or palms in all the lands of Egypt.” (Exodus 10:14–15). Swarms of locusts are still a very real plague today.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… darkness that can be felt … covered all Egypt for three days,” reports the Bible. “No one could see anyone else … for three days.” (Exodus 10:22–23). Dust storms frequently paralyze public life during the storm season in many of the most arid regions of the Earth, burying roads and human settlements, threatening the lives of humans and animals alike.

programme.title: Children of the Wild
programme.desc: In many cultures there are myths about “wolf children” who were taken from their families and then grew up in the wild, either alone or with wolves, bears or other animals. But how close are such stories to reality? This program offers a combination of two stories: the true story of the monkey boy John Ssebunya in Uganda, and that of Rudyard Kipling’s Mowgli, the most famous, albeit fictitious, wolf child of all. Unlike the children in the myths and stories, children who grow up without human beings have massive problems integrating themselves into society. The program specifically follows the fate of the young Ugandan boy John Ssebunya. If there is no human being as communication partner in the first years of a child’s life, the wolf child will yelp, growl, scream or grunt. He is not yet ready to make contact with other children.

programme.title: The Silicon Valley Revolution - How a few nerds did change the world
programme.sub-title: From Hippies to the first PC
programme.desc: Todays’ Silicon Valley is the home for multi-million dollar IT companies. In the beginning, however, it was unsophisticated, colourful, chaotic, and revolutionary. Hippies and amateur entrepreneurs initiated an unprecedented revolution: the pioneers of the PC wanted to change the world in an attempt to dethrone the “Big Brother”.

programme.title: Camp Century
programme.desc: In 1959 the USA decided to build a military town under the ice sheet of North Greenland. The superpower wanted to use all its might to gain a strategic advantage over the Soviet Union.

programme.title: The Advance of the Hanseatic League
programme.desc: At the bottom of the Baltic Sea lies a cog, a relic of the might of the German Hanse, a league of merchantmen founded about 1200 AD. Archaeologists are retracing its final voyage using state of the art technology as well as ancient scripts. Their search takes them to the Norwegian port of Bergen, to the Shetlands and even as far as Iceland.

programme.title: Expedition in the South Seas
programme.desc: He is one of the greatest German explorers of all time even though his name fell into oblivion: As luck would have it, in 1772 17-year-old Georg Forster was given the chance to accompany the greatest navigator of his time, James Cook, on his world circumnavigation. On this voyage, Captain Cook discovered islands and peoples, while Georg Forster focused on animals and plants, discovering more than 400 species that had been unknown to Europeans until then. “Terra X” follows German actor Robert Atzorn on his search for traces around the world. He gets to know a young man, whose philosophy and conception of the world still appear to be really modern. Sophisticated dramatic reconstructions bring the fateful sea journey to life. The film portrays a great natural scientist whose knowledge and legacy determined patterns for scientific research in the 21st century.

programme.title: Expedition to Eternal Ice
programme.desc: In the spring of 1930, when Alfred Wegener sets off on his third Greenland expedition, he hopes it will be the crowning glory of his career. Just a few years earlier he created a furore when he published his theory of continental drift; now he intends to revolutionise climatic research. For a whole year he and his team will compile data from high in the atmosphere and deep in the ice sheet. This is to be the first long-term climatic study ever carried out, and it marks the beginning of modern climatic research. Some of the scientists will venture far into the interior of the country and even set up a research station on the ice. This, the aptly named Inland Ice, will be 400 km away from the base camp on the West Coast, and specially constructed motorised propeller sleds will be used to transport not only the construction materials for the station but also provisions to see them through the long winter. Wegener has planned the expedition meticulously, down to the tiniest detail – but things don't turn out as he hoped. Right at the start the weather upsets his calculations. He loses six valuable weeks, and it then emerges that the propeller sleds don't work properly. They will have to resort to dog sleds for all their transportation needs. Despite the unfavourable circumstances, the scientists begin work in the middle of the ice sheet… even though they don't have enough provisions for the winter. Supplies are to be brought out to them later, but then the weather takes a dramatic turn for the worse, and Alfred Wegener and his men are faced with a race against time, their very lives at stake. A race they will ultimately lose.

programme.title: In Search of the Golden Fleece
programme.desc: When Jason and his crew of 50 men set sail, a dangerous journey to what was then known as the end of the world lies ahead of the Greek heroes. The young hero had a one-of-a-kind galley built for the voyage, which he baptized "Argo." The mighty rowing boat was designed to take the committed band to the legendary land of Colchis, beyond the Dardanelles.

programme.title: Wandering Wolves
programme.desc: For most Europeans, the wolf is more of a myth than an actual wild animal. But since the nineties, Isengrim has been making his way back to the middle of the continent, kilometre by painstaking kilometre. Part One of ‘Wandering Wolves’ follows the renowned biologist Francesca Marucco and other experts on the trail of an Italian nomad wolf on his way to the French Maritime Alps.

programme.title: Wandering Wolves
programme.desc: In Part Two of the documentary, the wolf experts Luigi Boitani, Francesca Marucco, Ilka Reinhardt and Hubert Potocnik track the animals all the way across Europe. We see how wolves often cover over a thousand kilometres on their migrations. They swim through fast-flowing rivers and traverse icy mountain ranges and multi-lane motorways.

programme.title: Casanova - the Art of Seduction
programme.desc: Giacomo Casanova was born in Venice in 1725, to poor parents. Initially, he is expected to become a priest, but he is ultimately going to reject this career path. His destiny is governed by the love of women, and he challenges the most powerful institutions of his time: the Catholic Church and the Venetian Inquisition. For Casanova, life in decadent Venice is an on-going feast for the senses.

programme.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
programme.desc: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone."

programme.sub-title: Rockwall Regional Pool Play Match - Arkansas vs. UT Dallas
programme.desc: Experience the intensity of collegiate pickleball as the University of Arkansas "Hogs" face off against UT Dallas in a high-stakes pool play matchup at the NCPA 2025 Dallas Regional. This "best-of-seven" format showcases the full spectrum of the sport, including gender doubles, singles, and mixed doubles, with teams competing for a prize pool and a coveted bid to the National Championship in St. Louis.The match features elite collegiate talent, including Arkansas’ Alison Lee and Yasmine Humbert, who bring high-energy play and powerful forehands to the court. They are met with fierce competition from UT Dallas standouts Chloe Tu, Alex Hayek, and Austin Lee. Watch as the teams battle through momentum shifts and high-speed hand battles at the kitchen line, ultimately leading to a high-pressure sudden death tiebreaker.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.sub-title: US Open 2025 - Pro Women's Doubles - Waters/Waters vs. Walczak/Harris
programme.desc: This Pro Women's Doubles match at the Minto US Open Pickleball Championships features the dynamic team of Anna Leigh Waters and Lee Waters facing off against the formidable duo of Walczak and Harris. The Waters team, known for their aggressive play and powerful shots, including Anna Leigh's unique heavy topspin cross-court backhand roll, aim to dominate the court. Walczak, a native of Poland with collegiate tennis experience, and Harris seek to overcome the Waters' early lead and challenge their expected path to the Championship court.

programme.desc: Monster Jam Replay arrives at the InTrustBank Arena in Wichita, Kansas, for a pivotal Round 8 of the Arena Championship Series West. Fans are treated to the technical brilliance of the Two Wheel Skills Challenge, featuring daring combos and gravity-defying maneuvers from the likes of Matt Cody in Grave Digger and Tim Hall Jr. in Jurassic Attack. The evening reaches a fever pitch during the Freestyle segment, where "Daredevil Diva" Angelina Nock takes Megalodon to the skies and Cliff Turner hunts for a breakthrough performance in Velociraptor. This episode highlights the 25th anniversary of the iconic El Toro Loco, with Joe Foley pushing the machine to its absolute limits in a pursuit of freestyle glory. Fans will witness the raw intensity of JCB Racing, technical brilliance in the Skills Challenge, and gravity-defying maneuvers in Freestyle, featuring a mix of legendary veterans and rising stars like Brandon Arthur.

Witness the high-stakes intensity of the "Good Vibes Tour" as rising star Brandon Arthur attempts to fill the massive shoes of Tristan England in JCB Digatron, challenging established titans for the overall event championship. The competition reaches a fever pitch across three grueling segments—JCB Racing, the technical Skills Challenge, and gravity-defying Freestyle—where every point is crucial for the season standings. From backflip attempts that push the 12,000-pound machines to their breaking point to the methodical precision required on the St. Louis dirt, this episode captures the raw power and rivalries of the world's most elite monster truck tour.

programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family

The walleye action doesn’t come easy—we bounce between proven hotspots, searching for the roaming schools. But once we dial them in, the bite ignites. Bradly gets his first real taste of fishing sunken timber, battling a walleye that wraps itself deep in a submerged tree, and from there the action never lets up. A perfect day in the North.

Just when you least expected it, Matt Newman caught his personal best-spotted bass, and a few minutes later, Paul Bailey caught the World Record Spotted Bass that weighed 11.5 on four different scales. The nation went bonkers. Today those three same guys are going fishing again at one of the world's best bass fishing lakes. Welcome to Clear Lake!

The lion's share of panfishing occurs during the springtime when the fish are concentrated in the shallow waters and also in the winter, but summertime can be absolutely fantastic for bluegill and crappie. programme.title: Best of Morning Footy
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

programme.desc: Oliver's (Eddie Albert) nephew Charles (Don Edmonds) arrives for a visit, and Oliver is completely shaken up when the boy turns out to be a long-haired, motorcycle-ridin', hippy-dippy type. But, boy, does he know a thing or two about engines.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver dreams of entering his crop in the Corn Festival, but the dreaded "Bing Bug" invades Hooterville's farms. After learning of his service as a WWII pilot, the locals volunteer him for the perilous task of flying the town's only crop duster.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: How To See South America By Bus
programme.desc: When a lovely, young and successful farmer comes to Oliver (Eddie Albert) for his legal counsel, Lisa (Eva Gabor) quickly becomes jealous of the two spending time together and becomes determined to break up what she sees as a budding romance.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Monroe Brothers show up to fix the Douglas's closet, Lisa learns that Ralph is devastated because her true love has stood her up on another date. Lisa's solution: an intensive, two-day beauty treatment for Ralph�and the barn for Oliver!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: One Of Our Assemblymen Is Missing
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) takes to his soap box, delivering fiery, patriotic speeches after getting a bill from the State Farm Unattached Duty Tax for an outrageous $12.03! But no one can figure out why the tax is levied in the first place.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is curious to learn about the book that Oliver (Eddie Albert) is reading. It is the "real-life" story of pioneers Gus and Etta Thompson. The episode flashes back to the 19th century with Oliver appearing as Gus and Lisa as Etta.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Eb Discovers The Birds And The Bees
programme.desc: Eb (Tom Lester) seeks dating advice from the Douglas's after laying eyes on former classmate Betty Jo Bradley from "petticoat Junction." Oliver's well-intentioned guidance has mixed results when Eb hilariously misconstrues the advice he's given.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The locals complain that Oliver's penchant for wearing business suits to do farm work is ruining Hooterville's image. Oliver tries to adjust, but the last laugh is on him when Lisa has her dressmaker design Italian him some swanky new overalls.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: You Ought To Be In Pictures
programme.desc: The Hooterville Chamber of Commerce attempts to attract a Hollywood film studio to shoot a movie in town. And when a rumor spreads that famous actor is arriving, the townsfolk are all abuzz as they prepare for their close-up, Mr. DeMille!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Home Isn't Built In A Day
programme.desc: Fed up with the house being in dire need of repair, Lisa demands that Oliver arrange to have the house redone or she's moving back to New York. Oliver agrees, but is delayed when Mr. Haney claims that their farmhouse is a historic monument.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Everything is topsy-turvy and henhouse hijinks ensue when one of the Douglas' hens is found to be laying square eggs! News of this kind gets around quickly, and the townsfolk all get in on the race to capitalize on the impressive novelty.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is absolutely determined to have a truly old-fashioned Christmas, including decorating his own farm-grown tree. But warm weather stands in the way and, he discovers, the residents of Hooterville aren't exactly as traditional as he thought.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Never Trust A Little Old Lady
programme.desc: In true Hooterville fashion, Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that the town is vehemently split as to which weather reporter they trust. As debates rage over which forecast is correct, Oliver plants his tomato crop, hoping for the best.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After another disastrous effort from Lisa in the kitchen, Oliver implores her to take a home economics class at the local high school. Before she knows it, Lisa is a fully enrolled student...the likes of which Hooterville High has never quite seen.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Hooterville City Council appoints Oliver (Eddie Albert) to judge the apple competition at the annual fair, he mistakes the honor for a real judgeship and prepares for his time on the bench! But a run-in with the real law clarifies matters.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: It's So Peaceful In The Country
programme.desc: Lisa visits Oliver's mother who is recovering from an illness. The doctor advises that she rest in a peaceful environment...and thinks that Hooterville sounds absolutely ideal! Of course, he doesn't know Hooterville, where peace is never�very close.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Hooterville has a still-valid contract to build war planes, he spearheads the opening of new government defense plant. But as chaos ensues, Oliver soon wonders if the move was a big mistake after all.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is appointed as head of Hooterville's new "Human Humane" committee. A perfect fit for animal-lover Lisa, and a relief from her boredom in the countryside, she soon has a menagerie of both farm and exotic animals living at Green Acres.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Never Take Your Wife To A Convention
programme.desc: Oliver takes Lisa along to an agricultural convention. There, Lisa bonds with an ex-gangster couple, who insist upon teaching the Douglas's some of their shortcuts to successful farming. It turns out to be an offer that Oliver can not refuse.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver champions agri-tech as way to increase productivity on the farm, but when a computer gives its assessment of the Douglas' marriage, Lisa (Eva Gabor) begins to question her union with Oliver. It's bits versus bytes in Green Acres!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his word�even the Air Force�and soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) is distraught when her beloved Mr. Kimball, is fired as the county agricultural agent. Out of a job, Kimball (Alvy Moore) no longer has money enough to marry the lady-carpenter-in-waiting! But wait�did he even want to?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hooterville�and she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.desc: Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

programme.desc: If you decide to purchase the Volkswagen Polo GTI or Citroen's DS4 SoChic you neither have to give up convenience nor performance. Also: Nissan doesn't hold back when it comes to their luxury brand Infiniti. We took the Q50 hybrid RWD to the test.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Not only in the big cities it's a growing struggle for parking spots. . We took the BMW X6, the Citroen Cactus and the Smart forfour to town in order to find out how these cars would cope in this situation and surrounding.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Cars with a rear-wheel drive are usually considered to be agile but also a bit capricious in regards to their handling. Does this also apply to the Porsche GT3 and the Smart? In addition: the sporty midsize sedan model range, BMW's 3 Series.

programme.title: The Dubai Police Force's Special Cars Unit

programme.title: Beradino

programme.title: 4x4

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: We show how to have a lot of fun on gravel roads in a Subaru WRX STI. Also: in the 1990s, Ford had a successful go at rally competitions with the Ford Escort RS Cosworth. And: the Volkswagen Polo WRC shows its 4x4 skills.

programme.title: Arabella Classics

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35

But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.

programme.title: Baselines
programme.desc: Set in Los Angeles, this series follows Jamiel Chambers, a blue chip high-schooler on the brink of escaping the desperate poverty that has berated inner city America. After his junior year ends with him leading his team to a second place finish in the state's regional tournament, Jamiel is hand-picked to play in the city's annual summer league All-Star game. With college recruits swarming and pro agents hedging, the media circus leans in, peddling the question mark around his future like rabid bookies. It is this exposure that gets the attention of Nick Collins, a derelict from a disreputable family from neighboring Irvine. After his doomed-from-the-start plan to capitalize on Jamiel's notoriety ends in with fatal results, family members from both sides are pulled into a series of events which will not only effect Jamiel's trajectory, but will set up one of the most intense family feuds the city has ever witnessed.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: In this episode set in scenic New Zealand, we explore the deep-rooted question: Does being near or in water actually improve our health? Guided by Dr. Wallace J. Nichols, author of "The Blue Mind," we delve into the scientific and emotional benefits of water, exemplified by therapeutic surfing experiences and the Maori people's ancestral connection to aquatic environments. From mental well-being to physical health, we uncover how New Zealand's abundant waters serve as more than just a natural spectacle; they are a source of holistic health and well-being. Along the way, Dr. Nichols introduces the concept of a "bluescription," a personalized prescription for water-based activities, inviting viewers to tap into the transformative power of water in their own lives.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E09 - Joshua Tree NB
programme.desc: In Joshua Tree, our journey began with Gabi, our knowledgeable astrology expert, who gracefully guided us through the mesmerizing wonders of the full moon, mercury retrogrades, and the celestial constellations. We then found ourselves immersed in the transformative realm of sound healing, led by the enchanting melodies of Alchemy. Marilia experienced profound rejuvenation as her body, mind, and soul were harmonized by the ethereal vibrations of diverse instruments.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E10 - L.A. NB
programme.desc: In the LA episode, our journey began with an awe-inspiring hike alongside the wolves. Wolf Connection revealed the magical nature of these animals and sparked a conversation about the connection between women and wolves. We then delved into Ayurveda, learning from Jay about the presence of nature in our bodies and how to maintain balance. Karla, an Ayurvedic chef, treated us to a delightful meal while emphasizing the importance of food for our well-being. Marilia fearlessly took a leap from an airplane, showing us how extreme sports can free us from fear. Lastly, Tracy showcased her life and passion for WCMX at the skate park, highlighting the joy found in pursuing our passions.

programme.title: Chasing The Sun
programme.sub-title: Chasing The Sun S01 E11 - Peru
programme.desc: Chasing the Sun, explores Peru's vibrant culture, bustling cities, and artistic spirit. From Lima's rich history and motor taxis to Barranco's music scene, discover inspiring stories of resilience, creativity, and the beauty of this remarkable country.

programme.title: Chasing The Sun
programme.sub-title: Chasing The Sun S01 E12 - Peru
programme.desc: Chasing the Sun, explores Peru's vibrant surf culture and community spirit. From Sofia Mulanovich's surf program to Diego's workshops for underprivileged kids, discover inspiring stories of resilience, environmental efforts, and the beauty of Peru.

programme.title: Epic Trails S02 E10 - Poland
programme.desc: Eric Hanson travels through southern Poland, beginning in Kraków and venturing into the country’s mountainous terrain. Alongside local guides, he explores national parks, braves unpredictable weather, and experiences Highlander traditions—from rafting and river crossings to enjoying smoky cheese and folk music. The journey ends with a dramatic climb up Mnich, highlighting Poland’s rugged beauty and rich culture of mountaineering.

programme.title: Race Across the World

programme.desc: If you were tasked to race across the world with limited cash and nothing in the way of modern technology, how do you think you’d fare? BBC2’s Race Across the World returns, as five teams attempt just that. This series takes viewers on the trip of a lifetime, following our contestants as they embark on an epic and adrenaline-fuelled adventure, travelling into the unknown without the trappings of modern life.

Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We travel the world to explore some of the highest peaks in "Bali". We'll visit its beautiful artistic monuments created for meditation, places in which we move to the past. We will enjoy the rich Balinese food, a contrast of flavors, aromas and color. Then, we will go to the South of France and visit the meticulously decorated Cathedral of St. John and explore the incredible beauty of the Basilica "Notre Dame" in Lyon. We will also walk through La Confluencia, a town in the city of Lyon with the most modern architecture, a true look to the future. To finish, we go to the surprising Island Country of Greenland. To admire some of the most incredible glaciers on earth. This land with 80% of ice has fantastic places to explore.

programme.desc: In this episode Phil takes us to the stunning Alila Villas Uluwatu on the Uluwatu Cliffs in Bali where, after a short tour of the property, he is greeted by Chef Stefan Zijta in the modern Indonesia restaurant, Warung, to watch as Stefan shows us how to prepare his interpretation of Indonesian cuisine.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Neven’s Greenway Food Trails
programme.desc: Cycling through some of Ireland’s most stunning scenery, chef Neven Maguire explores established Greenways such as The Great Western Greenway in Mayo, The Limerick, Waterford and Royal Canal Greenways; and he follows the routes of future Greenways planned for South Kerry and Connemara in Co. Galway. Along the way Neven meets some of Ireland’s most talented food producers and chefs in a variety of interesting locations. Ireland’s Greenways follow the routes of abandoned railway lines and canals which have been revitalised as cycling and walking tracks, passing through dramatic mountainous landscapes, lakeshores and seascapes. On his travels Neven also meets local historians who tell him all about these 19th century feats of engineering which had a transformative impact on the whole country. Many of the original aqueducts, viaducts and tunnels form part of the Greenways today and feature in the series.

programme.title: Follow Alana Taiwan
programme.desc: Follow Alana Taiwan delves into the sweeping natural landscapes and traditional community practices across Taiwan’s diverse islands, forests, villages, and more. In a refreshing departure from the Western world, Alana returns to the country she was born with a curious heart and familiar appetite for adventure.

programme.title: Neven’s Greenway Food Trails
programme.desc: Cycling through some of Ireland’s most stunning scenery, chef Neven Maguire explores established Greenways such as The Great Western Greenway in Mayo, The Limerick, Waterford and Royal Canal Greenways; and he follows the routes of future Greenways planned for South Kerry and Connemara in Co. Galway. Along the way Neven meets some of Ireland’s most talented food producers and chefs in a variety of interesting locations. Ireland’s Greenways follow the routes of abandoned railway lines and canals which have been revitalised as cycling and walking tracks, passing through dramatic mountainous landscapes, lakeshores and seascapes. On his travels Neven also meets local historians who tell him all about these 19th century feats of engineering which had a transformative impact on the whole country. Many of the original aqueducts, viaducts and tunnels form part of the Greenways today and feature in the series.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 61: Robert y la sucursal de Aruba
programme.desc: Robert quiere adelantar su boda con Inés para ir a atender la sucursal que tienen en Aruba, Armando se opone a la idea de Robert y le dice que como el ya regreso su cargo como presidente se le acabo. A Inés tampoco le gusto la idea. Daniela aprovecho el momento para solicitar ese puesto para su novio Luis Guillermo .Armando se burla de la sugerencia que le hace Daniela. Por otra parte Diego Andrés se encuentra a Maricela trabajando en una bomba de gasolina Maricela trata de que el no se de cuenta de que ella esta hay pero el la ve y sale corriendo detrás de ella pero no la logra alcanzar.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Abril lleva a Julie a ver a Inmaculada a la cárcel; pero Julie le dice que no quiere ser su hija. Penélope pone a Inmaculada en libertad y está enojada con todos en la Unidad de Homicidios, porque nadie leyó bien el expediente y una persona no puede ser juzgada dos veces, por el mismo caso. Julio va a la casa de Inmaculada y los dos enfrentan a Julie… Julio, cuenta lo sucedido, en ese entonces, no podía tener hijos con Vanessa, llevaban tiempo intentándolo y justo vio a una niña que recién había parido. Julio pensó entonces, como viviría esa bebé, con su madre, una niña pobre.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 73: Barbara enloquece; Lula y Fernando.
programme.desc: Socorro sufre al enterarse que Salvador sabía del amor que sentía su madre hacia él. Mercedes le dice a Ramiro que Bárbara no podrá participar en el reinado, porque no está bien mentalmente, Bárbara que escucha se pone como lo loca y utiliza a Ramiro para que cambie de decisión. - Lula y Fernando se besan, Charo ve esto y sigue a Lula en un auto, ve que se encuentra con unos niños (los hijos de Ramiro).

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 73: El Amor Se Consuma En El Agua
programme.desc: Ricardo le jura a su mama, mientras que Marisela le indica que no puede ser, porque ellos son hermanos. Ricardo lanza el teléfono al agua, y se reúne con Gabriela que lo esta esperando en el agua, se besan con pasión, y él le dice que nunca había sentido tanto amor por nadie, como lo estaba sintiendo por ella, Gabriela le dice que aún conociendo toda la verdad, aún la seguía amando, Ricardo le dice que si, que el tampoco es el que ella creía, se acarician y consumen su amor. Mientras que Jesús le pregunta a Marisela que donde esta ese muchacho para irlo a buscar para caerle a palos, y Marisela le dice que no sabe, que Ricardo solo le dijo que estaban en el lugar mas lindo que el había visto en su vida

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 116: El embarazo, los celos y la Nena.
programme.desc: Gladis se le acerca a su hijo y le pregunta que si conoce al hombre que se acaba de ir, el muchacho le responde que si, y que le da dinero para que le cuide la camioneta, ella queda muy preocupada, ahora ve a Aristigueta en todos lados. Aurelio sigue burlándose de Dileidi, con eso de que Luis Fernando se fue con la miss fue a terminar con ella. Luis Fernando y María Gracia todavía están impactados con la noticia de que están embarazados, no saben que hacer, cada uno piensa en los planes que tenían, que no era precisamente el de criar a un hijo. Egleé termina su jornada un poco cansada, Santiago la invita a tomar algo, pero ella como siempre se niega, el la convence, pues los que la preocupan no están en la oficina, así que será mas fácil. Betzaida no puede creer que Rómulo este tan pendiente de ella, el le dice que para eso esta el para cuidarla, salvo por un pequeño detalle, tiene que ir para la oficina a buscar un trabajo que le quedo pendiente, pero el supone que Marco Aurelio entenderá la emergencia que se le presento, Nely que esta con ellos, le dice que no importa que se vaya que ella cuidara de su hija mientras el regresa, Betzaida esta que mata a su mamá, por primera vez Rómulo se interesa por ella y viene su mamá a entorpecerle la cosa, bueno Rómulo aprovecha y se escapa. Entre tanto Egleé y Santiago salen de la oficina y en la parte abajo del edificio, el insiste en convencerla, ella se rehúsa un poco, el usa la táctica de los besos y en ese momento que pasa Rómulo por allí, pues iba a buscar unos planos en la oficina, ve justo cuando su ex se besa con Santiago, su primer impulso fue acercarse a ellos y armar un escándalo, pero afortunadamente Marco Aurelio que pasaba también por allí lo evita, le recuerda que ya el no tiene que ver nada con Egleé, que ya están divorciados, por lo tanto ella puede hacer lo que mejor le parezca con su vida y nadie tiene por que meterse y mucho menos el que esta esperando un bebe con su nueva esposa, a Rómulo no le queda mas remedio que reconocer que su amigo tiene toda la razón, Marco Aurelio insiste en que se vayan a tomar algo, pero el prefiere quedarse, una vez que queda solo de nuevo, Santiago se lo tropieza pues subió a la oficina a buscarle las llaves del carro a Egleé, sin mediar palabra alguna, Rómulo le lanza un golpe en la cara, Egleé se da cuenta de lo que pasa y se pone furiosa, le dice a Rómulo que, que es lo que le pasa, que ella va a llamar a Betzaida para decirle lo que esta pasando con su marido, Rómulo lo evita, luego Santiago le dice que no le devuelve el golpe por respeto a Egleé y a la amistad que tiene con Luis Fernando, ahí vuelve de nuevo Rómulo y arremete con Santiago de nuevo pero esta vez de forma verbal, Egleé le pide que se vaya y que la deje en paz. Los futuros padres o sea la miss y Luis Fernando aún no reaccionan, hasta que ella le dice que se van a tener que casar, Luis Fernando casi se infarta cuando escucho eso, piensa que no es necesario que se casen, pero ella le dice que si no lo hacen su familia la matara, ella tiene que hacer las cosas bien, no dirán que se casan por que ella esta embarazada, el no haya que decir, siente que ahora si perderá definitivamente a Dileidi. Mientras tanto ella espera la llegada de su novio, que no termina de llegar y cada vez mas siente que todo como que fue una mentira mas de el. En la casa de Egleé están curando a Santiago, Egleé esta muy nerviosa todavía, su mamá la trata de calmar, llega Luis Fernando y cuando le pregunta a Santiago si lo que dieron fue un golpe el lo niega, le dice que fue un archivador que le cayo encima. Lo mismo le dice Rómulo a su mujer, que le cura la mano con hielo, ella que conoce muy bien la oficina no entiende cual archivador pudo ser, le pregunta si la señora Egleé no tuvo nada que ver con ese golpe y el lo niega. Gonzalo sueña con Yenilu, quien le recuerda que desde hace mucho tiempo ninguna mujer se interesa por el, Matilde se sospecha que algo le pasa a su marido, seguro que querrá pelea esa noche, justo cuando ella no puede, pero Gonzalo ni cerca de eso, le pregunta a Ramón si el no ha tenido una aventura con alguien a lo que Ramón le dice que no, que con esa mujer que el tiene es imposible. Se reúnen todas en la casa de Egleé, Pascuita cree que Egleé esta mal por lo del embarazo de Rómulo, ella le dice que para nada, luego pasan al tema de la Nena, quien le cuenta a sus amigas que ya no haya que hacer para quitarse a Aristigueta de encima, todas están de acuerdo que ella a quien ama es a Theo, con todo y su bajo nivel adquisitivo. Theo le cuenta a Gabito que el brujo le dijo que la Nena lo quiere, Gabito le dice que el se lo esta diciendo desde hace rato, que eso no era necesario que se lo dijera ningún brujo. Gladis ve a sus hijos y se siente orgullosa de la familia que ella sola ha levantado, sin la ayuda de ningún hombre, son sus hijos, solos de ella y de nadie mas. Theo espera que aunque sea la Nena se asome a la ventana para verla de lejos, no es por otra cosa, es solo para verla, ella que sale en ese momento de la casa de Egleé lo ve y se le acerca, los dos se miran y algo sorprendidos se quedan como paralizados.

Ricardo lanza el teléfono al agua, y se reúne con Gabriela que lo esta esperando en el agua, se besan con pasión, y él le dice que nunca había sentido tanto amor por nadie, como lo estaba sintiendo por ella, Gabriela le dice que aún conociendo toda la verdad, aún la seguía amando, Ricardo le dice que si, que el tampoco es el que ella creía, se acarician y consumen su amor. Mientras que Jesús le pregunta a Marisela que donde esta ese muchacho para irlo a buscar para caerle a palos, y Marisela le dice que no sabe, que Ricardo solo le dijo que estaban en el lugar mas lindo que el había visto en su vida

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 116: El embarazo, los celos y la Nena.
programme.desc: Gladis se le acerca a su hijo y le pregunta que si conoce al hombre que se acaba de ir, el muchacho le responde que si, y que le da dinero para que le cuide la camioneta, ella queda muy preocupada, ahora ve a Aristigueta en todos lados. Aurelio sigue burlándose de Dileidi, con eso de que Luis Fernando se fue con la miss fue a terminar con ella. Luis Fernando y María Gracia todavía están impactados con la noticia de que están embarazados, no saben que hacer, cada uno piensa en los planes que tenían, que no era precisamente el de criar a un hijo. Egleé termina su jornada un poco cansada, Santiago la invita a tomar algo, pero ella como siempre se niega, el la convence, pues los que la preocupan no están en la oficina, así que será mas fácil. Betzaida no puede creer que Rómulo este tan pendiente de ella, el le dice que para eso esta el para cuidarla, salvo por un pequeño detalle, tiene que ir para la oficina a buscar un trabajo que le quedo pendiente, pero el supone que Marco Aurelio entenderá la emergencia que se le presento, Nely que esta con ellos, le dice que no importa que se vaya que ella cuidara de su hija mientras el regresa, Betzaida esta que mata a su mamá, por primera vez Rómulo se interesa por ella y viene su mamá a entorpecerle la cosa, bueno Rómulo aprovecha y se escapa. Entre tanto Egleé y Santiago salen de la oficina y en la parte abajo del edificio, el insiste en convencerla, ella se rehúsa un poco, el usa la táctica de los besos y en ese momento que pasa Rómulo por allí, pues iba a buscar unos planos en la oficina, ve justo cuando su ex se besa con Santiago, su primer impulso fue acercarse a ellos y armar un escándalo, pero afortunadamente Marco Aurelio que pasaba también por allí lo evita, le recuerda que ya el no tiene que ver nada con Egleé, que ya están divorciados, por lo tanto ella puede hacer lo que mejor le parezca con su vida y nadie tiene por que meterse y mucho menos el que esta esperando un bebe con su nueva esposa, a Rómulo no le queda mas remedio que reconocer que su amigo tiene toda la razón, Marco Aurelio insiste en que se vayan a tomar algo, pero el prefiere quedarse, una vez que queda solo de nuevo, Santiago se lo tropieza pues subió a la oficina a buscarle las llaves del carro a Egleé, sin mediar palabra alguna, Rómulo le lanza un golpe en la cara, Egleé se da cuenta de lo que pasa y se pone furiosa, le dice a Rómulo que, que es lo que le pasa, que ella va a llamar a Betzaida para decirle lo que esta pasando con su marido, Rómulo lo evita, luego Santiago le dice que no le devuelve el golpe por respeto a Egleé y a la amistad que tiene con Luis Fernando, ahí vuelve de nuevo Rómulo y arremete con Santiago de nuevo pero esta vez de forma verbal, Egleé le pide que se vaya y que la deje en paz. Los futuros padres o sea la miss y Luis Fernando aún no reaccionan, hasta que ella le dice que se van a tener que casar, Luis Fernando casi se infarta cuando escucho eso, piensa que no es necesario que se casen, pero ella le dice que si no lo hacen su familia la matara, ella tiene que hacer las cosas bien, no dirán que se casan por que ella esta embarazada, el no haya que decir, siente que ahora si perderá definitivamente a Dileidi. Mientras tanto ella espera la llegada de su novio, que no termina de llegar y cada vez mas siente que todo como que fue una mentira mas de el. En la casa de Egleé están curando a Santiago, Egleé esta muy nerviosa todavía, su mamá la trata de calmar, llega Luis Fernando y cuando le pregunta a Santiago si lo que dieron fue un golpe el lo niega, le dice que fue un archivador que le cayo encima. Lo mismo le dice Rómulo a su mujer, que le cura la mano con hielo, ella que conoce muy bien la oficina no entiende cual archivador pudo ser, le pregunta si la señora Egleé no tuvo nada que ver con ese golpe y el lo niega. Gonzalo sueña con Yenilu, quien le recuerda que desde hace mucho tiempo ninguna mujer se interesa por el, Matilde se sospecha que algo le pasa a su marido, seguro que querrá pelea esa noche, justo cuando ella no puede, pero Gonzalo ni cerca de eso, le pregunta a Ramón si el no ha tenido una aventura con alguien a lo que Ramón le dice que no, que con esa mujer que el tiene es imposible. Se reúnen todas en la casa de Egleé, Pascuita cree que Egleé esta mal por lo del embarazo de Rómulo, ella le dice que para nada, luego pasan al tema de la Nena, quien le cuenta a sus amigas que ya no haya que hacer para quitarse a Aristigueta de encima, todas están de acuerdo que ella a quien ama es a Theo, con todo y su bajo nivel adquisitivo. Theo le cuenta a Gabito que el brujo le dijo que la Nena lo quiere, Gabito le dice que el se lo esta diciendo desde hace rato, que eso no era necesario que se lo dijera ningún brujo. Gladis ve a sus hijos y se siente orgullosa de la familia que ella sola ha levantado, sin la ayuda de ningún hombre, son sus hijos, solos de ella y de nadie mas. Theo espera que aunque sea la Nena se asome a la ventana para verla de lejos, no es por otra cosa, es solo para verla, ella que sale en ese momento de la casa de Egleé lo ve y se le acerca, los dos se miran y algo sorprendidos se quedan como paralizados.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 61: Robert y la sucursal de Aruba
programme.desc: Robert quiere adelantar su boda con Inés para ir a atender la sucursal que tienen en Aruba, Armando se opone a la idea de Robert y le dice que como el ya regreso su cargo como presidente se le acabo. A Inés tampoco le gusto la idea. Daniela aprovecho el momento para solicitar ese puesto para su novio Luis Guillermo .Armando se burla de la sugerencia que le hace Daniela. Por otra parte Diego Andrés se encuentra a Maricela trabajando en una bomba de gasolina Maricela trata de que el no se de cuenta de que ella esta hay pero el la ve y sale corriendo detrás de ella pero no la logra alcanzar.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Abril lleva a Julie a ver a Inmaculada a la cárcel; pero Julie le dice que no quiere ser su hija. Penélope pone a Inmaculada en libertad y está enojada con todos en la Unidad de Homicidios, porque nadie leyó bien el expediente y una persona no puede ser juzgada dos veces, por el mismo caso. Julio va a la casa de Inmaculada y los dos enfrentan a Julie… Julio, cuenta lo sucedido, en ese entonces, no podía tener hijos con Vanessa, llevaban tiempo intentándolo y justo vio a una niña que recién había parido. Julio pensó entonces, como viviría esa bebé, con su madre, una niña pobre.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 73: Barbara enloquece; Lula y Fernando.
programme.desc: Socorro sufre al enterarse que Salvador sabía del amor que sentía su madre hacia él. Mercedes le dice a Ramiro que Bárbara no podrá participar en el reinado, porque no está bien mentalmente, Bárbara que escucha se pone como lo loca y utiliza a Ramiro para que cambie de decisión. - Lula y Fernando se besan, Charo ve esto y sigue a Lula en un auto, ve que se encuentra con unos niños (los hijos de Ramiro).
